questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Thailand?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “History” part of the Thailand article.

questions.proof: The founding of Bangkok as the capital city, was the start of the Rattanakosin Kingdom (1782–1932).

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Its neighbours are _____, Cambodia, Malaysia, and Myanmar.”

hints.nudge: The missing word is a name, not an everyday word. Only one of these names makes the sentence true.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Thailand article.

questions.proof: Its neighbours are Laos, Cambodia, Malaysia, and Myanmar.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Industry had a contribution to the GDP, of 43.9 percent (in _____), and 14 percent of the workforce are in that sector (of the economy).”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twenty-first century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Economy” part of the Thailand article.

questions.proof: Industry had a contribution to the GDP, of 43.9 percent (in 2007), and 14 percent of the workforce are in that sector (of the economy).

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “57 people died (year _____), in the conflict.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twenty-first century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Armed conflict in the provinces Narathiwat, Pattani, and Yala” part of the Thailand article.

questions.proofSection: Armed conflict in the provinces Narathiwat, Pattani, and Yala

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “In regard to tourism: From each of these four countries, there came one million tourists during 2025's first six months: _____, China, India and Russia.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “months”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Thailand article, under the heading “Economy”.

questions.proof: In regard to tourism: From each of these four countries, there came one million tourists during 2025's first six months: Malaysia, China, India and Russia.
